Research Methods Field Notes
Coastal water quality pilot, synthetic teaching packet
Key question: Can a simple field protocol detect a short-lived turbidity spike after rainfall?
Protocol
• collect three surface samples at each site
• record air temperature, water temperature, and turbidity
• rinse the probe before every site change
• flag readings that differ from the site median by more than 15 percent
Site Time Turbidity NTU Note
A 08:10 2.1 baseline
B 08:40 8.4 after rainfall
C 09:15 3.0 downstream recovery
Equation note
Mean turbidity = (x_A + x_B + x_C) / 3. Use this as a quick screening value, not as a substitute for reviewing
each reading.
